context: Continuous selling on 12 Oct in NIFTY, BankNIFTY and SENSEX, so sellers are now the seated side in all three.
plan: FLAT TO GAP UP -> BUY: the continuous selling seated sellers in all three indices -- identify buying-side setups to target them.
GAP DOWN -> SELL, WITH THE MARKET: on a gap down the seated sellers sit in profit and in confidence, so they cannot be targeted -- identify selling-side setups.
